steps.name: environment
steps.description: Prepare persistent runtime environment for headless runs: create workspace, set ownership, write /etc/profile.d/vite_env.sh with runtime-parameterized NODE_ENV and PORT defaults and append the expanded workspace node_modules/.bin into PATH. Validate Node and npm numeric versions (require node >=18, npm >=8) and report detected versions. Source the profile explicitly in later steps when needed.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/vite_env.sh
# create workspace and set ownership for invoking user
sudo mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$WORKSPACE"
# Write a deterministic profile that uses runtime parameter expansion for NODE_ENV and PORT and appends workspace node bin
sudo bash -c "cat > $PROFILE <<'EOF'
# Vite headless defaults
export NODE_ENV="${NODE_ENV:-development}"
export PORT="${PORT:-5173}"
# add user's npm global if present and workspace local node bin
export PATH="${HOME}/.npm-global/bin:$PATH:$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin"
EOF"
sudo chmod 0644 "$PROFILE" || true
# Validate Node and npm numeric major versions and report
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "error: node not found" >&2; exit 2; fi
NODE_VER=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || true)
NODE_MAJOR=$(node -p "Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0])" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 18 ]; then echo "error: node >=18 required, found $NODE_VER" >&2; exit 2; else echo "node $NODE_VER"; fi
if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "error: npm not found" >&2; exit 2; fi
NPM_VER=$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || true)
# parse npm major safely via node to avoid pre-release parsing issues
NPM_MAJOR=$(node -e "console.log(require('child_process').execSync('npm -v').toString().trim().split('.')[0])" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if [ "$NPM_MAJOR" -lt 8 ]; then echo "error: npm >=8 recommended, found $NPM_VER" >&2; exit 2; else echo "npm $NPM_VER"; fi
# Note: profile will be sourced explicitly by subsequent steps when required to pick up PATH changes

steps.name: scaffold-project
steps.description: Idempotently scaffold a Vite + React + TypeScript project in the workspace non-interactively. If workspace empty and no package.json, run documented 'npm init vite@latest' non-interactively with the react-ts template. If package.json exists, do not rerun init; instead create any missing tsconfig.json, src files, and index.html so a minimal app exists.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer" cd "$WORKSPACE" # If no package.json and directory empty, initialize a Vite react-ts project non-interactively if [ ! -f package.json ]; then if [ "$(ls -A | wc -l)" -eq 0 ]; then # Use documented npm init invocation; pass --yes to npm init if supported to avoid prompts if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm init vite@latest . -- --template react-ts --yes >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm init vite@latest . -- --template react-ts >/dev/null 2>&1 else echo "error: npm not available to scaffold" >&2; exit 3 fi else echo "package.json missing but workspace non-empty; will create minimal files without running create-vite" >&2 fi else echo "package.json exists; preserving project and creating missing scaffold files" fi # Create minimal tsconfig.json if missing if [ ! -f tsconfig.json ]; then cat > tsconfig.json <<'TS' { "compilerOptions": {"target":"ES2020","lib":["DOM","ES2020"],"jsx":"react-jsx","module":"ESNext","moduleResolution":"Node","strict":true}, "include":["src"] } TS fi mkdir -p src if [ ! -f src/main.tsx ]; then cat > src/main.tsx <<'TS' import React from 'react' import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client' import App from './App' createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render() TS fi if [ ! -f src/App.tsx ]; then cat > src/App.tsx <<'TS' import React from 'react' export default function App(){return
Hello Vite+React+TS
} TS fi if [ ! -f index.html ]; then cat > index.html <<'HTML' Vite App
HTML fi # Ensure package.json has minimal scripts; preserve existing fields if [ -f package.json ]; then node -e "let fs=require('fs');let p=fs.existsSync('package.json')?require('./package.json'):{}; p.scripts=p.scripts||{}; if(!p.scripts.dev) p.scripts.dev='vite'; if(!p.scripts.build) p.scripts.build='vite build'; if(!p.scripts.serve) p.scripts.serve='serve -s dist -l \$PORT'; if(!p.scripts.test) p.scripts.test='vitest --run --reporter=dot'; fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2))" else # create a minimal package.json so installs work cat > package.json <<'PJ' { "name":"vite-react-ts-app", "version":"0.0.0", "private":true, "scripts":{"dev":"vite","build":"vite build","serve":"serve -s dist -l $PORT","test":"vitest --run --reporter=dot"} } PJ fi

steps.name: install-dependencies
steps.description: Install project-local runtime and dev dependencies. Prefer npm (per requirements). If package-lock.json exists run 'npm ci' explicitly (not as root) to ensure lockfile integrity; otherwise install minimal required deps for build and tests. Detect local binaries in ./node_modules/.bin and avoid 'npx --no-install' reliance. Ensure installs are performed as the non-root invoking user to avoid permission issues.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo 'error: package.json missing, run scaffold first' >&2; exit 4; }
# Source profile to pick up PATH additions for local node bins if needed
[ -f /etc/profile.d/vite_env.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/vite_env.sh || true
# Prefer npm unless yarn.lock exists and yarn binary present
PM=npm
if [ -f yarn.lock ] && command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then PM=yarn; fi
# If lockfile exists, use lockfile-respecting install
if [ "$PM" = "npm" ] && [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
elif [ "$PM" = "yarn" ] && [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
  yarn install --frozen-lockfile --silent
else
  # Ensure minimal runtime and dev deps exist in package.json; install missing deps
  NEED_RUNTIME=(react react-dom vite)
  NEED_DEV=(typescript @types/react @types/react-dom vitest jsdom @testing-library/react @testing-library/jest-dom serve cross-env)
  MISSING_RUNTIME=()
  MISSING_DEV=()
  for d in "${NEED_RUNTIME[@]}"; do grep -q "\"$d\"" package.json || MISSING_RUNTIME+=("$d"); done
  for d in "${NEED_DEV[@]}"; do grep -q "\"$d\"" package.json || MISSING_DEV+=("$d"); done
  if [ ${#MISSING_RUNTIME[@]} -gt 0 ]; then npm i --no-audit --no-fund "${MISSING_RUNTIME[@]}"; fi
  if [ ${#MISSING_DEV[@]} -gt 0 ]; then npm i -D --no-audit --no-fund "${MISSING_DEV[@]}"; fi
fi
# Verify local bins exist (prefer ./node_modules/.bin)
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/vite ]; then ./node_modules/.bin/vite --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; else echo "warning: vite not found in node_modules/.bin" >&2; fi
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/vitest ]; then ./node_modules/.bin/vitest --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; else echo "warning: vitest not found in node_modules/.bin" >&2; fi
# Log versions
node -e "console.log('node',process.versions.node)"
npm -v || true

[ -f package.json ] || { echo 'error: package.json missing, run scaffold first' >&2; exit 4; }
# Source profile to pick up PATH additions for local node bins if present
[ -f /etc/profile.d/vite_env.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/vite_env.sh || true
# Run as invoking non-root user when possible: detect SUDO_USER or fall back to current user
INVOKING_USER=${SUDO_USER:-$(id -un)}
# Prefer npm unless yarn.lock exists and yarn binary present
PM=npm
if [ -f yarn.lock ] && command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then PM=yarn; fi
# Use npm ci if lockfile exists and npm is chosen

  if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "${SUDO_USER:-}" ]; then
    sudo -H -u "$INVOKING_USER" bash -c "npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent"
  else
    npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent
  fi
elif [ "$PM" = "yarn" ] && [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
  if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "${SUDO_USER:-}" ]; then
    sudo -H -u "$INVOKING_USER" bash -c "yarn install --frozen-lockfile --silent"
  else
    yarn install --frozen-lockfile --silent
  fi
else
  # Ensure minimal runtime and dev deps exist in package.json; install missing deps only
  NEED_RUNTIME=(react react-dom vite)
  NEED_DEV=(typescript @types/react @types/react-dom vitest jsdom @testing-library/react @testing-library/jest-dom serve cross-env)
  MISSING_RUNTIME=()
  MISSING_DEV=()

  for d in "${NEED_DEV[@]}"; do grep -q "\"$d\"" package.json || MISSING_DEV+=("$d"); done
  if [ ${#MISSING_RUNTIME[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "${SUDO_USER:-}" ]; then
      sudo -H -u "$INVOKING_USER" bash -c "npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent ${MISSING_RUNTIME[*]}"
    else
      npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent "${MISSING_RUNTIME[@]}"
    fi
  fi
  if [ ${#MISSING_DEV[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "${SUDO_USER:-}" ]; then
      sudo -H -u "$INVOKING_USER" bash -c "npm i -D --no-audit --no-fund --silent ${MISSING_DEV[*]}"
    else
      npm i -D --no-audit --no-fund --silent "${MISSING_DEV[@]}"
    fi
  fi
fi
# Verify local bins exist (prefer ./node_modules/.bin)
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/vite ]; then
  ./node_modules/.bin/vite --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
else
  echo "warning: vite not found in node_modules/.bin" >&2
fi
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/vitest ]; then
  ./node_modules/.bin/vitest --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
else
  echo "warning: vitest not found in node_modules/.bin" >&2
fi
# Log versions (numeric validation not enforced here; environment expected to have node>=18 and npm>=8)
NODE_VER=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
NPM_VER=$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
echo "node ${NODE_VER}"
echo "npm ${NPM_VER}"
# Ensure workspace ./node_modules/.bin is available in profile for future shells
if [ -d "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin" ]; then
  PROFILE_FILE=/etc/profile.d/vite_env.sh
  BIN_EXPORT="export PATH=\"$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin:\$PATH\""
  if [ -w /etc/profile.d ] && ( ! [ -f "$PROFILE_FILE" ] || ! grep -Fq "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin" "$PROFILE_FILE" ); then
    sudo bash -c "cat > $PROFILE_FILE <<'EOF'
# Vite workspace env: add project-local node bins
export NODE_ENV=development
export PORT=5173
$BIN_EXPORT
EOF
"
  fi
fi

steps.name: setup-testing
steps.description: Configure Vitest to run in jsdom, create a JS-based setup bootstrap to avoid TypeScript bootstrap problems, add a sanity test, ensure testing libs are installed, and run tests deterministically via local executable invocation (npm exec).
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo 'error: package.json missing' >&2; exit 4; }
# Source profile to ensure PATH includes workspace node bin
[ -f /etc/profile.d/vite_env.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/vite_env.sh || true
# Ensure vitest config in package.json: environment=jsdom and setupFiles
node -e "let fs=require('fs');let p=fs.existsSync('package.json')?require('./package.json'):{}; p.vitest=p.vitest||{}; p.vitest.environment='jsdom'; p.vitest.setupFiles=p.vitest.setupFiles||['vitest.setup.js']; p.scripts=p.scripts||{}; p.scripts.test='vitest --run --reporter=dot'; fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2))"
# Create JS setup file to avoid TypeScript startup issues
if [ ! -f vitest.setup.js ]; then cat > vitest.setup.js <<'JS'
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'
JS
fi
# Create minimal test
mkdir -p test
if [ ! -f test/App.test.tsx ]; then cat > test/App.test.tsx <<'TS'
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import React from 'react'
import { render } from '@testing-library/react'
import App from '../src/App'

describe('App', ()=>{ it('renders', ()=>{ const {getByText}=render(<App/>); expect(getByText('Hello Vite+React+TS')).toBeTruthy(); }) })
TS
fi
# Ensure test deps installed; install only if missing
NEEDED=("vitest" "@testing-library/react" "@testing-library/jest-dom" "jsdom")
MISSING=()
for p in "${NEEDED[@]}"; do [ -d "node_modules/$p" ] || MISSING+=("$p"); done
if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -gt 0 ]; then npm i -D --no-audit --no-fund "${MISSING[@]}"; fi
# Run tests via npm exec to use local binary
npm exec -- vitest --run --reporter=dot || (echo 'tests failed' >&2; exit 6)

Hello Vite+React+TS
} TS fi mkdir -p test if [ ! -f test/App.test.tsx ]; then cat > test/App.test.tsx <<'TS' import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest' import React from 'react' import { render } from '@testing-library/react' import App from '../src/App' describe('App', ()=>{ it('renders', ()=>{ const {getByText}=render(); expect(getByText('Hello Vite+React+TS')).toBeTruthy(); }) }) TS fi # Ensure test deps installed; install only if missing NEEDED=("vitest" "@testing-library/react" "@testing-library/jest-dom" "jsdom") MISSING=() for p in "${NEEDED[@]}"; do if [ ! -d "node_modules/$p" ]; then MISSING+=("$p"); fi done if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -gt 0 ]; then npm i -D --no-audit --no-fund --no-fallback --silent "${MISSING[@]}" fi # Ensure local node bin is on PATH for npm exec (also source profile again) [ -f /etc/profile.d/vite_env.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/vite_env.sh || true # Run tests via npm exec to use local binary deterministically if ! npm exec -- vitest --run --reporter=dot; then echo 'tests failed' >&2 exit 6 fi echo 'vitest tests passed'

steps.name: validate-build-and-run
steps.description: Build the Vite app, serve the static build using the project-local serve binary (avoid npx auto-install), start server in its own process group to ensure full cleanup, perform HTTP health-checks with retries and timeouts, then stop the server cleanly. Source /etc/profile.d/vite_env.sh explicitly at start to pick up NODE_ENV/PORT.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Source profile so PORT/NODE_ENV are consistent
[ -f /etc/profile.d/vite_env.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/vite_env.sh || true
PORT=${PORT:-5173}
NODE_ENV=${NODE_ENV:-production}
# Build using local vite if available, prefer npm exec -- vite when available
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/vite ]; then ./node_modules/.bin/vite build; elif command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm exec -- vite build; else npm run build; fi
# Determine serve binary: prefer local node_modules/.bin/serve
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/serve ]; then SERVE_BIN="./node_modules/.bin/serve"; else echo "error: serve binary not found; please install 'serve'" >&2; exit 6; fi
LOGFILE="$WORKSPACE/serve.log"
# Start serve in a new process group so we can kill group later
setsid "$SERVE_BIN" -s dist -l "$PORT" >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
SERVE_PID=$!
# obtain PGID for cleanup
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$SERVE_PID" | tr -d ' ' || true)
trap 'if [ -n """$PGID""" ]; then kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi' EXIT INT TERM
# Health check with retries
RETRIES=12; SLEEP=1; OK=1
for i in $(seq 1 $RETRIES); do
  if curl --max-time 2 -sSf "http://localhost:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then OK=0; break; fi
  sleep $SLEEP
done
# Clean shutdown
if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
sleep 1
if [ $OK -eq 0 ]; then echo "validation: ok (http://localhost:$PORT/)"; exit 0; else echo "validation: failed, see $LOGFILE" >&2; exit 6; fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
PID_FILE="$WORKSPACE/serve.pid"
PGID_FILE="$WORKSPACE/serve.pgid"
if [ -f "$PGID_FILE" ]; then
  PGID=$(cat "$PGID_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then
    kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    sleep 1
  fi
fi
if [ -f "$PID_FILE" ]; then
  PID=$(cat "$PID_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$PID" ]; then
    kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    rm -f "$PID_FILE"
  fi
fi
rm -f "$PGID_FILE"
